name: look1-to-worship-full
_comment: Example of the sequence described for Look 1 -> Worship Full. Capture looks named 'look1', 'display-fullframe' (display box in its full-screen position) and 'worship-imag' (two imag boxes in blend position) first, and replace MAIN_DISPLAY_INPUT (16) with the real ATEM input number for the display source.
